:::{#thm-ppv-bayes}
#### PPV from Bayes' theorem

Let $\text{sens}$ be the [sensitivity](#def-sensitivity) of a diagnostic test,
$\text{spec}$ its [specificity](#def-specificity),
and $\prev$ the [prevalence](#def-prevalence) of the disease.
Then the [positive predictive value](#def-ppv) of the test is:

$$
\text{PPV} =
\frac{\text{sens} \cd \prev}
{\text{sens} \cd \prev + \paren{1 - \text{spec}} \cd \paren{1 - \prev}}
$$ {#eq-ppv-bayes}

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-ppv-bayes, worked in @sol-ppv-bayes,
which builds on @thm-prob-positive.

:::
